items.text: Seasonal dungeons will no longer spawn inside player-owned private buildings.
Halloween NPCs no longer appear inside safezones.
Dead Halloween and Easter candy items are cleared on server restart, preventing them from persisting indefinitely.
Food no longer spoils inside the workbench recycle bin upgrade container.
Server crash risk from exceeding Steam key limits is mitigated; the limit now lasts up to a year, and new keys stop after 50k unique values.
Thrown weapons now display correctly on the death screen after dying.
Main menu rendering issue fixed; menu now appears reliably.
Added new sound events for sheep foot stomp, cow head shake, and livestock petting (moo, baa, scratch gestures).
Fixed lingering sounds from destroyed monument entities when loading.
Hidden players now rank behind visible players in PT boat targeting, but can still be selected if no visible players are present.
Corrected PT boat target loss logic: boats now only give up on targets 12 units below sea level, not above.
Added SetVehicleLoad and retuned vehicle haptics; improved seat‑check logic for more accurate haptic feedback.
First‑person lasers now function correctly.
Triangle spiral stairs now include the missing upkeep component, enabling proper decay and maintenance.
Fixed controller stick drift by ignoring pad stick input when not the active device, and corrected gamepad duck‑latching to prevent escape‑menu input issues.
Halloween 2026 DLC items corrected: lights are now craftable with proper stack size and cost, and alien suit hitbox fixed to block legs instead of torso.
Refrigeration now only triggers in arctic biomes covering at least 10% of the area, preventing unintended cooling in tiny arctic patches.
Resolved regression where player boat privileges were lost when using the building‑privilege cache.
Fixed scaling bug causing explosives attached to solar panels to be sized incorrectly.
Lingering sounds from destroyed monuments no longer persist after loading.
Sheep and cows now have richer interactions: new footstep and head‑shake sound cues, plus petting reactions with moo/baa sounds and scratch gestures.
Gamepad input handling refined: inactive sticks ignored to prevent drift, and duck‑latching logic fixed to stop escape‑menu input clearing issues.
Hidden players now rank behind visible players in targeting, but can still be selected if no visible targets exist.
Patrol boats no longer abandon targets above sea level, fixing altitude targeting bug.
First‑person laser weapons now function correctly.
Player boat privileges restored when using the privilege cache.
Halloween DLC items fixed: lights are craftable with correct stack size and cost, and alien suit armor fits correctly.
Weapon drop behavior improved: mag drop system unified with glass AK implementation and unnecessary cachedPostIK removed.
Triangle spiral stairs now include an upkeep component, ensuring proper decay handling.
Arctic biome refrigeration now requires at least 10% biome presence, preventing unintended refrigeration in minimal arctic areas.
Explosives attached to solar panels now scale correctly, preserving size and functionality.

2026-10-12.summary:
### Audio & Animal Interaction
- Lingering sounds from destroyed monuments no longer persist after loading.
- Sheep and cows now have richer interactions: new footstep and head‑shake sound cues, plus petting reactions with moo/baa sounds and scratch gestures.

### Controls
- Gamepad input handling refined: inactive sticks ignored to prevent drift, and duck‑latching logic fixed to stop escape‑menu input clearing issues.

### Combat & Targeting
- Hidden players now rank behind visible players in targeting, but can still be selected if no visible targets exist.
- Patrol boats no longer abandon targets above sea level, fixing altitude targeting bug.
- First‑person laser weapons now function correctly.

### Vehicles & Boats
- Player boat privileges restored when using the privilege cache.

### Crafting & Items
- Halloween DLC items fixed: lights are craftable with correct stack size and cost, and alien suit armor fits correctly.
- Weapon drop behavior improved: mag drop system unified with glass AK implementation and unnecessary cachedPostIK removed.

### Environment & Structures
- Triangle spiral stairs now include an upkeep component, ensuring proper decay handling.
- Arctic biome refrigeration now requires at least 10% biome presence, preventing unintended refrigeration in minimal arctic areas.
- Explosives attached to solar panels now scale correctly, preserving size and functionality.

items.text: Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.
Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.
Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.
Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.
Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

2026-10-11.summary:
### Structures
- Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.

### Cosmetics
- Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.

### Vehicles & Mounts
- Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.

### Livestock & Farming
- Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
- Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

items.text: Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.
Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.

2026-10-10.summary:
### Resources & Farming
- Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.
